# ClarSim Hair Braiding

> Hair braiding studio based in Austin, Texas. Knotless and box braids, boho curls, twists, Fulani and lemonade braids and cornrows by Clarisse on North Lamar. Clean parts, careful hands, and a chair where you can relax.

- Phone: (737) 349-1000
- Based in: Austin, TX
- Nearby areas: Austin, Pflugerville, Round Rock, Manor, Cedar Park
- Google rating: 5.0 from 15 reviews
- Book an appointment: https://ronaks-code.github.io/sitelift-demos/braiding-salons/texas/clarsim-hair-braiding/quote.html
- Pick a time: https://ronaks-code.github.io/sitelift-demos/braiding-salons/texas/clarsim-hair-braiding/book.html

## Services
- Knotless braids: Medium to small knotless braids, shoulder to waist length, with clean, even parts and less tension at the scalp.
- Box & jumbo box braids: Classic box braids with neat, structured parts, or jumbo box braids for a bold, full look.
- Boho braids: Knotless boho braids and boho chic braids with loose, flowing curls through the length for a soft, full finish.
- Senegalese & kinky twists: Smooth Senegalese rope twists or full, textured kinky twists, worn down or up in buns and ponytails.
- Fulani & lemonade braids: Cornrow patterns into long braids: Fulani styles that take beads and cuffs, and side-swept lemonade braids over one shoulder.
- Cornrows, kids & men: Straight-back and feed-in cornrows, with or without added hair, plus gentle, neat styles for kids and cornrows for men and boys.

## About
ClarSim Hair Braiding is Clarisse's chair in Suite A144 at 7801 N Lamar Blvd, inside the Sadi's Beauty Works salon in North Austin, with parking right out front. Inside it is calm and bright: black chairs, framed mirrors and cream walls. Clarisse has more than 20 years in the beauty industry. She braids for women, men and children, from knotless and box braids to twists, Fulani and lemonade braids and cornrows, and she also does sew-in extensions for extra length and volume. What clients say most is that the work is neat and the pace is right. She doesn't rush, pays close attention to every part, and still gets you done in good time. Clients come back, and they bring their kids.

## Frequently asked questions
- Q: How much do braids cost?
  A: Men's and boys' cornrows start at $70, medium knotless braids at $150, Senegalese twists at $180, and most full braid styles run $190 to $260 depending on size and length. See the full menu on the services page.
- Q: How do I book?
  A: Book online on Booksy, call or text (737) 349-1000, or send a request on this site with the style you want. A $10 deposit holds your spot, so book early.
- Q: What are your hours?
  A: Monday to Saturday, 7:30 AM to 8:30 PM. Closed Sunday. Holiday hours can change, so call (737) 349-1000 if you're not sure.
- Q: Where are you?
  A: Suite A144 at 7801 N Lamar Blvd, Austin, TX 78752, inside Sadi's Beauty Works in North Austin. There is parking right out front, and it is an easy drive from Pflugerville, Round Rock, Manor and Cedar Park.
- Q: Do you braid kids' and men's hair?
  A: Yes. Kids and teens are welcome, and men's and boys' cornrows are on the menu, from a few rows to a full head.
- Q: How long do braids take?
  A: Cornrows take 30 minutes to 2 hours. Most braid and twist styles take about 3 to 5 hours, and small waist-length knotless braids can take closer to 6.
